entries.05431ed97597b680: To use its owned real estate efficiently, the company leases part of its owned real estate, including surplus space it does not use itself. This is carried out by the company and its consolidated subsidiary Apuris Co., Ltd. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥39 million.
entries.0e7ce144ec6cd6f4: A tutoring school consisting of an individual tutoring division and a class instruction division. Mainly under 'Kobetsu Shido Gakuin Free Step', individual tutoring is also operated under the names 'Kaisei Kyoiku Group Sundai Diverse', 'Free Step 1-on-1 Senmon-kan Sophia', 'Chugaku Juken/Daigaku Juken Senmon Kobetsu Shido Arusupōto', 'Shinken Zemi Kobetsu Shido Course' and 'Jisedaigata Kobetsu Shido Juku Sumanabi'; Free Step also operates a franchise business. Class instruction based on class formation by academic level is provided under the names 'Kaisei Kyoiku Seminar' and 'Ēru Shingaku Kyōshitsu', and it also operates 'Ikkai Juku', specializing in preparation for medical school and highly competitive university entrance examinations. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,595 million.
entries.27b202420e07a323: It operates 'IVYKIDS', an English conversation school with after-school childcare; 'Kaisei Academy Japanese Language School', targeting international students; and 'Kaisei Academy Korean Language School', specializing in intermediate and advanced Korean. It also provides job-search consulting for Japanese-affiliated companies in Seoul, Republic of Korea; operates a kindergarten in the Socialist Republic of Vietnam; dispatches instructors to school corporations; dispatches foreign instructors who use English as an official language; and produces educational content software. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥702 million.
entries.4d26872833a8dbea: Apuris Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, operates one restaurant in Osaka City. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥67 million.
entries.abe14ee319131fae: It operates the authorized nursery school 'Kaisei Hoikuen', the small-scale authorized nursery school 'Kaisei Petit Hoikuen', and the authorized nursery school and small-scale authorized nursery school 'Aiterasu Hoikuen', operated in Kobe City, Hyogo Prefecture. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,752 million.
entries.b022d91d1579db35: This is the core business undertaken by the company and its consolidated subsidiaries, providing academic instruction and childcare through the individual tutoring division, class instruction division, childcare division and other instruction division. The company operates classrooms and other facilities in the Kinki region centered on Osaka Prefecture, the Kanto region centered on Tokyo Metropolis, and overseas. As of March 31, 2026, there were 277 directly operated classrooms and 52 franchise classrooms. As of the end of November 2025, the group's enrolled students numbered 28,010. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥15,050 million, accounting for 99.3% of consolidated revenue.
